issue: वेद विमल यश गाऊँ: the words leave the Vedas' part open.
our reading: let me sing your pure glory, of which the Vedas sing
alternatives: let me sing your glory, pure as the Vedas

issue: भक्त विभीषण लंक पधारे: the subject is Vibhīṣaṇa by the words; it may mean the Lord went to Laṅkā for his devotee Vibhīṣaṇa.
our reading: his devotee Vibhīṣaṇa went to Laṅkā
alternatives: for his devotee Vibhīṣaṇa, he went to Laṅkā

issue: तुलसी को पत्र कण्ठ मणि हीरा: read as a list (a tulasī leaf; a gem and a diamond at his throat); it may say that the tulasī leaf is the gem and diamond of his throat.
our reading: A tulasī leaf, a gem and a diamond at his throat
alternatives: the tulasī leaf at his throat is his gem and diamond
